_what: S30 — each pack's printed code is a serial number of an item that has both batches and serial numbers. apply_config.py sets Stock Settings, a Defective store and the items; migrate.py moves a unit table onto those items; units_report.py says what became of each unit. Change the names to the shop's. Names start with 'PP USN' / 'PP-USN' so they are easy to tell from the shop's own; --remove undoes only what apply_config.py recorded making.
